quests.title: Remnants of the Shadow Realm

dialogue.t: We've now secured all the ancient relics within these ruins. Thanks for all your hard work, {NICKNAME}. This gives me a lot of valuable research material.

dialogue.sit: I've gained a lot from this, too.

dialogue.t: What do you think, {NICKNAME}? How's your gun handling now with all the new bells and whistles?
Heh. To be honest, the add-ons aren't what make the difference. The key with guns is practice — enough hits on target, and it eventually becomes second nature.
If you ever get the chance, you should come hunting with me. I learned all my gunslinging skills out in the wild.

quests.description: You have finally finished your excavation of the relics within the ruins
